MORE THAN A BEAUTIFUL FINISH

A little science.
A whole lot of shine.

Ceramic coating is a liquid polymer that bonds with your paint. Nanotechnology fills microscopic surface pores, creating a durable, hydrophobic layer that makes everyday care easier.

Long-lasting paint protection

A durable shield against UV rays, oxidation, bird droppings, sap, and light scratches.

Deep gloss. Mirror finish.

A rich, wet-look shine that brings out your paint’s depth and color, long after the detail.

Water beads. Dirt leaves.

Hydrophobic protection helps water, dirt, and grime slide off, making washes easier and faster.

An extra layer of defense

Scratch and chemical resistance helps minimize swirl marks and environmental damage.

Ceramic coating is not scratch-proof or a substitute for paint protection film. Proper care still matters.

GOOD QUESTIONS. STRAIGHT ANSWERS.

Before your car
gets the spotlight.

What is the current ceramic coating offer?

The source offer is premium 10-year ceramic coating for $599, normally $1,200, for a limited time. Contact the shop to confirm availability and what your vehicle needs.

What does “up to a 10-year warranty” mean?

The advertised coating offers up to 10 years of warranty and durability. Ask Super Shine about the specific coverage, eligibility, and maintenance requirements for your vehicle before booking.

Will ceramic coating prevent every scratch?

No. It helps resist light scratches, swirl marks, chemicals, and environmental contamination, but it is not scratch-proof. Ask about paint protection film (PPF) for a different level of physical protection.
